title: St. Louis man sentenced for the fatal shooting of WashU MFA student
summary_en: On May 21, 2026, a man involved in the fatal shooting of WashU Master of Fine Arts (MFA) student Amarnath Ghosh was sentenced to 15 years in prison. 48-year-old Glen L. Bailey was initially charged with first-degree murder and pleaded guilty to voluntary manslaughter as part of a plea deal. Prosecutors said Bailey sold drugs in the area and had driven two other men to the intersection in the Acade
author: Tanvi Gorre
title_cn: St. Louis man sentenced for the fatal shooting of WashU MFA student
